texts: On day 690 of Year 2, Old Vesh asked the Council whether the sealed records in the Watch should be opened.
Brindle Coombe argued that the sealed records had been sealed for a reason.
Meren Tallowhand agreed with Brindle Coombe.
Old Vesh said that the open records alone shaped the village's memory.
The Council declined to open the sealed records.
The Council agreed to revisit the question at the autumn-equinox meeting.

q1_issues.issue: "agreed with" is an eventive verb (it passes the progressive test — "they are agreeing"), so its subject should be Agent, not the stative-psych Experiencer; the same parse correctly uses Agent for agree at index 41.

"agreed WITH Brindle Coombe" is a prepositional verb whose object must go in the preposition-named oblique (With ...) — the instruction set's own "dealt with the appeal" case — not in the psych role Stimulus.

(Time sk_revisit_1 sk_meeting_1) puts an event-denoting entity witness in the Time slot, which takes calendar/clock structured terms or deictic/named time constants; "at the autumn-equinox meeting" is the preposition-named oblique (At ...), by the same line that sends "in the final round" to In rather than During/Time.

q2_gaps: A graded/weak deontic inside a seal ("asked whether the records SHOULD be opened") — "should" is specified as (Obligated e) at strength 0.7, but a sealed complement is one term carrying a single STV, so the weakening has no carrier and the seal records a flat Obligated; this is the strength analogue of the registered no-polarity-in-seal limitation, which the document states only for negation.

The interim projection table lists only Member/Name typing as projecting out of an attitude seal, and says nothing about a definite PLURAL referent's GroupOf (or Cardinality) atom — the parse projects (GroupOf sk_records_1 record) and (GroupOf sk_records_2 record) to top level, which is the sensible reading but is not licensed by the table as written.
review.notes: The seals themselves are well built — Whether for the indirect polar question, sealed Past for the past perfect with no cross-seal Before, indefinite "a reason" kept inside while definite typing projects, and "sealed"/"open" distributed as per-member rules inside the seal. "Declined to open" follows the control-verb doctrine exactly, which does leave the opening's atoms asserted at top level at full strength — a consequence of the doctrine, not a parse defect.

issues.reason: "Agree" accepts the progressive ("they are agreeing"), so it is eventive, and the instruction set reserves Experiencer for a holder "exactly when the complement seals" — with a PP object and no sealed complement the subject is an ordinary Agent, as the same parse has for agree at index 41.

The real half stands — Stimulus is defined only as a psych state's object, so it is unlicensed once the subject is not an Experiencer — but that (With ...) is the uniquely licensed remedy is overstated: the instruction set's own Reciprocals example puts "argue with"'s object in Theme, and CoAgent covers an animate comitative "with", with no stated tie-break.

The Time slot takes structured calendar/clock terms or deictic/named time constants, never an entity witness, and the instruction set explicitly routes a framing NP like "in the final round" to the preposition-named oblique, so (Time sk_revisit_1 sk_meeting_1) is ill-typed where (At sk_revisit_1 sk_meeting_1) is licensed.

gaps_confirmed: A weak deontic inside a seal ("whether the records should be opened"): "should" is (Obligated e) at strength 0.7, but a sealed complement is one term under a single STV, so the weakening has no carrier — the strength analogue of the registered no-polarity-in-seal limitation.

The interim projection table licenses only Member/Name typing out of an attitude seal and never names a definite PLURAL's GroupOf, which the strength-0 denial rule does name explicitly; the parse's top-level GroupOf is the evident intent but is not literally licensed by the table as written.
new_gaps: No tie-break for a prepositional-verb "with" taking an animate object ("agreed with Brindle Coombe"): the mechanical prepositional-verb rule sends the NP to the (With ...) oblique, Reciprocals assigns "argue with"'s object to Theme, and Thematic roles offers CoAgent for a comitative "with" — three licensed-looking forms for one clause.

A negative-implicative control verb ("declined / refused / failed to V") routes through the control-verb doctrine, which reifies the complement as asserted top-level class and role atoms with NO carrier for the non-occurrence the sentence states — while the parallel refusal wording "would not V" is explicitly given the strength-0 denial bundle; a licensed form would need to record that the complement event did not occur.
"day 690 of Year 2" is a day-of-year ordinal with no month, but (Day <n>) is specified only as a calendar date's day-of-month, so the two readings are indistinguishable downstream.
adjudication.defect_summary: For "Meren Tallowhand agreed with Brindle Coombe" the compliant form is (Agent sk_agree_1 meren_tallowhand) with the with-phrase moved out of Stimulus — to the preposition-named (With sk_agree_1 brindle_coombe) or to the Theme the instruction set's own "argue with" example uses, a choice it does not settle (filed in new_gaps); for the revisit clause the compliant form is the preposition-named oblique (At sk_revisit_1 sk_meeting_1), the meeting's typing and genus atoms unchanged.
adjudication.notes: The seals are well built — Whether for the polar indirect question, sealed Past with no ordering atom crossing the seal, the indefinite "a reason" and the LocatedIn / Possession restrictors kept inside while definite typing projects. All confirmed defects are role- and slot-choices outside the seals.
